heard: Seven Earth-sized planets are crammed inside the orbit of Mercury. They circle a red dwarf star barely larger than Jupiter. On the world Trappist 1e, one full year lasts just six days. It stays permanently locked, with one side always facing its sun. One half is scorched desert, the other is frozen night. Electric currents from intense stellar winds may be stripping its air. This world hangs between a lush paradise and a barren, airless stone, all while remaining just one of seven worlds packed inside Mercury's orbit.
